high_level_description: This image captures a scene of a road during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues near the horizon and the darker tones higher up in the sky. The sky is filled with clouds, some of which are illuminated by the sun, creating a dramatic contrast between light and shadow. The road itself is wet, suggesting recent rain, and there are a few vehicles on it. A white car is driving away from the camera, while a larger vehicle, possibly a bus, is parked or moving slowly on the right side of the road.
